product_metadata.title: GXAO Nutcracker Christmas Decorations, Outdoor Xmas Decor, Soldier Model Nutcracker Banners for Front Door Porch Garden Indoor Exterior Kids Party, with 83 PCS Free Window Clings
features: Package includes–2 soldier Nutcracker Banners,83 PCS Free Window Clings. Bring the Christmas spirit with these Christmas decorations.

Featuring a regal uniform, they make charming decorative statements for Entry Way, Fireplace, Living room, Kitchen, Lawn or garden, Garage, Balcony and so on. Work great as Classroom, Store, Party Decor as well.
LIFE SIZE. Measure 14" x 74", fit the door perfect.
Suitable for both indoor and outdoor purposes. Made of weather resistant 600D polyester Oxford Fabric. Come assembled with rod and string. Ready to hang.
These Free Christmas window clings decals is a perfect way to decorate your window, glass door and winter wonderland party.
